title: StashAway首席配置官：科技七巨头陷入“无人区”，前景存疑
speaker: Stephanie Lung

segments.en: Why do you think we're seeing a massive pullback right now in specifically mag seven? And would you buy that dip specifically?
segments.zh: 为什么你认为科技七巨头现在出现大幅回调？你会趁低买入吗？

segments.en: Yeah. I think, if you look at a mag seven this year, I think as you've shown in the chart just now, I mean, they have really underperformed. So when we look at, for example, during the first half, S&P was actually up around 10%, but the mag seven was flat. So the rest of the 493 actually outperformed the mag seven significantly in the past six months.
segments.zh: 是的，今年科技七巨头表现落后。上半年标普500上涨约10%，但七巨头基本持平。其他493只股票过去六个月显著跑赢七巨头。

segments.en: And a lot of that of course was trimmed by the AI hardware names, but like half of that also was trimmed by the broader market. So I think if you think about the mag seven, of course, they were the darlings of the last decade or so. And it was the era of social media. It was the era of cloud. Now we're moving on to the era of AI. And as we look at kind of broader index, even if you look at S&P during different periods, different leaderships.
segments.zh: 其中一部分是AI硬件股拖累，但另一半是整体市场因素。七巨头曾是过去十年的宠儿，那是社交媒体和云计算的年代。现在进入AI时代，标普500在不同时期有不同的领涨板块。

segments.en: So I think the question mark is, okay, is like companies like Open AI and Frappe are going to become the more important companies compared to the mag seven. And in particular, again, the mag seven right now is spending a lot of CapEx before, I mean, it offers a lot of safety for investors, a lot of cash flow. Now that it's being put in a question mark, so I mean, mag seven right now, if you compare it to the best growth companies, they're not the highest in growth. If you compare the safest companies, they're not the safest ones. So there's kind of a, it's somewhere in between in No Man's Land, I would say. So I mean, I think that's a that's a question mark going forward for for mag seven as a whole.
segments.zh: 问题是，像OpenAI和Frappe这样的公司是否会比七巨头更重要？七巨头目前资本开支巨大，过去提供安全性和现金流，但现在这些优势存疑。与最佳成长股比，它们成长性不足；与最安全股票比，它们安全性不够。可以说它们处于“无人区”。这是七巨头整体面临的问题。
